name: n8n_executions
description: Manage workflow executions: get details, list, or delete. Use action='get' with id for execution details, action='list' for listing executions, action='delete' to remove execution record.

action.description: Operation: get=get execution details, list=list executions, delete=delete execution

id.description: Execution ID (required for action=get or action=delete)

mode.description: For action=get: preview=structure only, summary=2 items (default), filtered=custom, full=all data, error=optimized error debugging

nodeNames.description: For action=get with mode=filtered: filter to specific nodes by name

itemsLimit.description: For action=get with mode=filtered: items per node (0=structure, 2=default, -1=unlimited)

includeInputData.description: For action=get: include input data in addition to output (default: false)

errorItemsLimit.description: For action=get with mode=error: sample items from upstream node (default: 2, max: 100)

includeStackTrace.description: For action=get with mode=error: include full stack trace (default: false, shows truncated)

includeExecutionPath.description: For action=get with mode=error: include execution path leading to error (default: true)

fetchWorkflow.description: For action=get with mode=error: fetch workflow for accurate upstream detection (default: true)

limit.description: For action=list: number of executions to return (1-100, default: 100)

cursor.description: For action=list: pagination cursor from previous response

workflowId.description: For action=list: filter by workflow ID

projectId.description: For action=list: filter by project ID (enterprise feature)

status.description: For action=list: filter by execution status

includeData.description: For action=list: include execution data (default: false)
